description: Weekly payer follow-up: we check every pending payer enrollment application every week until the payer approves or denies it, and email you within one business day when a payer is missing a document; with the application bundle we first write and submit the application. Send an email, the plan and how you will give access (payer portal user, PECOS surrogate, delegation letter, CAQH admin invite, or call only). Group and per-application plans take the roster as NPIs and the pending applications (clinician NPI, payer, state, date submitted; payer reference number and notes optional). The application bundle takes applications_to_submit (clinician NPI, payer, state, and documents: caqh to use the clinician's CAQH profile, or send to send the license, malpractice certificate, W-9 and CV or work history; notes optional); where a payer requires the clinician's own signature, the clinician signs or attests. The reply has a Stripe checkout link and an access token, shown once, that opens the status later; nothing is checked until payment. Group plan: $15 per clinician per month for the whole roster (weekly license, Medicare revalidation, exclusion list and NPI registry monitoring, only changes reported, plus a CAQH re-attestation and Medicare revalidation calendar), plus $149 per month for each clinician with a pending application, until all their applications are decided or six months. Per-application plan: $29 per application, checked weekly until decided, up to 120 days, then $4 per check; optional roster monitoring $3 per clinician per month. Application bundle: $129 per application, paid up front, one checkout line per application, written, submitted and checked weekly until decided. Cancel subscriptions any time, from the next month. Not included: appeals, contract or rate negotiation. Up to 500 clinicians and 300 applications; up to 100 applications per bundle.
